rca of the issue: Remaining bug RCA: The Emergent platform-injected badge (id=emergent-badge) is a fixed-position <a> at bottom-right with its own text content that captures pointer events. On a 1920px viewport it renders ~170px wide × ~40px tall. The chat form's right padding of 128px (md:pr-32) still leaves the last ~128px for the send button, which is entirely inside the badge's hit area. Increasing right padding to at least pr-44 (176px) — or adding pb-10 to raise the row above the badge — will clear the safe area. Reproduction: open /ai in desktop viewport 1920×1080, type any text, Playwright click on [data-testid=chat-send-btn] → click times out with 'emergent-badge subtree intercepts pointer events'.
